title: Check Hospital HMI Alarms List and Timestamp for Active Alarms
summary: Use the Hospital HMI Alarms screen to identify active alarm entries and their timestamps. Then match the Alarm Text/ID to the manual’s Alarms and Corrective Actions table to determine the documented Cause and Corrective Action for the specific alarm.
when_to_use: When the system is showing an alarm/fault condition at the Hospital station and you need to identify the specific active alarm text/ID and its timestamp so the correct documented corrective action can be applied.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Open the Hospital HMI, view the Alarms screen, record the Alarm Text and ID for the active alarm(s), and use the manual alarm table to select the documented corrective action.
access_or_tools_needed: Hospital HMI / lane UI (Hospital HMI Alarms screen)

access_required: Access to the Hospital HMI / lane UI
system_preconditions: Hospital HMI is powered and reachable to display the Alarms screen
external_references: OptiSweep Operation and Maintenance Manual Table 4-23: Alarms and Corrective Actions

visual_references.description: Hospital HMI Alarms screen showing a list of active alarms with timestamps (Figure 4-42).

steps.title: Open the Hospital HMI Alarms screen
steps.purpose: Get to the screen that lists all alarms and their timestamps for the Hospital station.
steps.instruction: On the Hospital HMI / lane UI, navigate to the Alarms screen (Hospital HMI Alarms Screen, Figure 4-42).
steps.expected_result: The Hospital HMI Alarms screen is displayed and shows a list of alarms along with a time stamp.
steps.healthy_condition: A visible alarms list is present and each alarm entry has an associated time stamp.
steps.failure_condition: The Alarms screen shows no alarm entries while an alarm/fault condition is expected.

actions.label: Navigate to Alarms screen
actions.exact_action: Open the Hospital HMI and navigate to the Alarms screen (Figure 4-42: Hospital HMI Alarms Screen).

stop_or_escalate_if: Alarm list is empty when an alarm condition is expected.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “The Alarms screen provides a list of all alarms along with a time stamp.”

steps.title: Verify alarms list and timestamps are present
steps.purpose: Confirm the screen is populated so you can identify the active alarm(s) and their timestamps.
steps.instruction: On the Hospital HMI Alarms screen, verify that the alarms list rows are present and that each alarm entry includes a time stamp.
steps.expected_result: The screen shows active alarm entries and a time stamp for each entry.
steps.healthy_condition: Each visible alarm row includes a timestamp value.
steps.failure_condition: Alarm entries are missing or timestamps are not shown for entries.

actions.label: Check alarms list rows and timestamp column/field
actions.exact_action: Verify the screen shows a list of alarms and a time stamp for each alarm entry.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “The Alarms screen provides a list of all alarms along with a time stamp.”

steps.title: Record the active alarm Alarm Text and ID
steps.purpose: Capture the exact Alarm Text and associated ID so the correct row in Table 4-23 can be matched.
steps.instruction: For the alarm(s) currently relevant to the issue, record the Alarm Text and the associated ID from the alarms list entry.
steps.expected_result: You have the Alarm Text and ID for the active alarm entry/entries that correspond to the observed system condition.
steps.healthy_condition: Alarm Text and ID are captured for each active alarm you intend to troubleshoot.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot determine the Alarm Text and/or ID from the alarms list entries.

actions.label: Record Alarm Text and ID
actions.exact_action: For the alarm(s) currently relevant to the issue, record the Alarm Text and the associated ID from the alarms list entry.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Below is a list of all possible alarms/faults and the corrective action required.” (Table 4-23 includes ID and Alarm Text.)

steps.title: Match Alarm Text/ID to Table 4-23 to determine Cause and Corrective Action
steps.purpose: Use the manual’s alarm mapping table to select the documented corrective action for the specific alarm.
steps.instruction: Using Table 4-23 (Alarms and Corrective Actions), match the recorded Alarm Text/ID to the corresponding row to identify the documented Cause and Corrective Action.
steps.expected_result: The recorded Alarm Text/ID matches a specific Table 4-23 entry that provides Cause and Corrective Action.
steps.healthy_condition: A single, clear Table 4-23 row is identified for the recorded Alarm Text/ID, and it includes Cause and Corrective Action fields.
steps.failure_condition: The alarm text/ID cannot be found in Table 4-23 entries.

actions.label: Use Table 4-23 mapping
actions.exact_action: Use the alarm table in the manual (Table 4-23: Alarms and Corrective Actions) to match the recorded Alarm Text/ID to the documented Cause and Corrective Action.

stop_or_escalate_if: Alarm text/ID cannot be matched to Table 4-23 entries.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Table 4-23 lists alarms/faults with ID, Alarm Text, Cause, Controller Response, and Corrective Action.”

success_criteria: Active alarm entry/entries are identified on the Hospital HMI Alarms screen with timestamps.
Alarm Text and ID for the relevant active alarm(s) are recorded.
The recorded Alarm Text/ID matches a Table 4-23 entry that provides Cause and Corrective Action.
healthy_conditions: Hospital HMI Alarms screen displays a list of alarms with a time stamp for each entry.
Alarm Text and ID can be read from the active alarm row(s).
Alarm Text/ID can be matched to Table 4-23 entries.
failure_conditions: Hospital HMI Alarms screen shows no alarm entries while an alarm/fault condition is expected.
Alarm text/ID shown on the Hospital HMI cannot be matched to Table 4-23 entries.
escalation_guidance: Escalate if the Alarms screen is empty when an alarm condition is expected.
Escalate if the alarm text/ID cannot be matched to Table 4-23 (Alarms and Corrective Actions) entries.
